title: Spent Fuel Pool Drum
description: The &3Spent Fuel Pool Drum&r is used to cool down hot nuclear fuel rods for the &3RBMK&r, &3ZIRNOX&r and &3PWR&r. It has 12 slots.
The drum needs to have at least one of its sides touching &bWater&r to work. The more sides that have water the faster the fuels inside will cool down.
